items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Count Basie and I had about 30 pupils between us, that we were teaching to play jazz.

ctx.x: Did whites come down to the black clubs?

Yes, whites came everywhere; that's the reason why the guys got into trouble. They were always in the black district. Count Basie and I had about 30 pupils between us, that we were teaching to play jazz.

items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: Great, then I'm going to see her Saturday.

ctx.x: Great, then I'm going to see her Saturday.
I'll give you her number -- well, I'm sure you'll be in touch with her.
